items.text: Rams star WR Puka Nacua recently had season-ending knee surgery.
items.implication: Out rest of regular season; elevates other LAR WRs/RBs like Kyren long-term.

items.text: Chiefs ruled out RB Kenneth Walker for Sunday vs. Cardinals due to groin injury; second straight miss with rookie Emmett Johnson starting again.
items.why: Groin injury; team exercising caution per Reid comments amplified.
items.implication: Emmett Johnson workhorse/RB1 opportunity vs ARI; Walker managers need pivot.

items.text: AJ Brown is expected to miss multiple weeks due to his hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; per Schefter and Mike Reiss.
items.implication: Significant absence; check NE/PHI depth for target bumps.

items.text: Jordan Addison ruled out (among Sunday outs list).
items.implication: More targets to Jefferson/others in MIN.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans is poised to make his return; questionable with real chance to go, Shanahan says going in right direction though a little sore.
items.why: Achilles; practice progress and coach comments.
items.implication: Potential ACTIVE boosts SF WR corps; monitor final inactive.
Game-time; if out elevates other LV pass-catchers.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith is officially back.
items.implication: Full role expected vs PIT; stabilizes PHI passing.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 31 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 31, Hutchinson 28, Tank Dell 17, Boutte 13. Marv inactive, Noel done for season. Doubt Dell exceeds half routes down stretch.
items.why: 100% route participation; high target share context.
items.implication: Locked WR1 usage with injuries around him; start confidently.

items.text: Justin Herzig buying Derrick Henry more excited about change in potential role from a pass-catching aspect.
items.implication: Boosts PPR value ROS if materializes.

items.text: Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson ROS? Give me Olave. Like Tyson but everyone else does too—trade him before deadline.
items.why: Prefer established over hype; sell-high on Tyson.
items.implication: Hold/start Olave; trade Tyson if possible.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) for Sunday vs Steelers.
items.implication: Minor target bump possible to Smith/Goedert if any.

items.text: Bills listing TE Dalton Kincaid as doubtful for Sunday vs Miami.
items.implication: Likely out; Knox or others benefit in BUF TE.

items.text: Keeping it open on Trey McBride. One quiet game with Beck does not erase elite target volume. Chiefs strong TE matchup, ARI should throw.
items.implication: Start with confidence despite prior quiet outing.

items.text: Garrett Wilson makes this week's LOVES list: 36% target share, 7/106 last, top-five matchup for opposing WRs. Not apologizing to managers.
